subject.title: feat(workspace): add tiered bootstrap loading with configurable bootstrapTier

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.defaults.bootstrapTier` as a new global config surface for tiered workspace bootstrap loading?
rationale: The implementation is plausible and proof-backed, but adding a new prompt/session-context config knob crosses the repository's high bar for config surfaces and affects upgrade-sensitive session state.

options.title: Sponsor and document
options.body: Approve the config direction, require public docs and refreshed exact-head validation, then continue reviewing this PR as the candidate fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/22438.

options.title: Defer to broader context policy
options.body: Pause or close this PR and keep the work under broader bootstrap/context-injection design such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/46565.

options.title: Decline the new knob
options.body: Keep existing bootstrapMaxChars, contextInjection, and hook behavior as the supported surfaces and close the paired feature direction.
